propositions: DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX default value (1800s) is too small; review deferral events on 2026-08-12 exceeded the bound by 10-130s (1810s, 1820s, 1810s, 1930s actual deferred_for against 1800s bound)
Each bound-exceeded firing killed an in-flight LLM-Review and stalled the gate, occurring ~10x the normal rate during a 60+-merge landing burst
Raising DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX from 1800s (1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) to 2400s (2.0x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) absorbs the observed 10-130s overshoots without addressing underlying saturation scenarios
The bound must remain anchored to a fixed multiple of the app's per-review cap so it self-adjusts when REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS changes, enforced by a test relationship assertion
The pinned test assertion must be tightened from >= 1.0x to >= 2.0x the per-review cap to enforce the new ratio and prevent future drift
For truly saturated episodes (in_flight oscillating without reaching zero), a larger bound only defers the kill; whether Aug-12 episodes were saturated remains unestablished
